start: Hello. I answer questions about your ALX lesson, only from the course, with a link to the part I used. Write, speak, or use the buttons below. /help shows every command.
consentAsk: To answer, I can send your question to an online AI service. Nothing about who you are is sent. Voice notes also need an online service.
consentNo: Use answers from the course only
consentSaved: Saved. You can change this with /consent.
notFound: I could not find this in the course. Send /person to reach a person.
noAdvice: I cannot give medical, legal or immigration advice. Send /person to reach a person.
voiceNeedsConsent: Voice needs online processing. Type your question, or allow online answers with /start.
voiceFailed: I couldn't understand the voice message. Please type it, or try again more slowly.
voiceBeta: Voice in this language is in beta.
voiceTooLong: This voice message is too long. Please send one under 20 MB, or type your question.
helpOnline: A tutor is joining. Their reply will come here. Request number: {id}
helpLater: A tutor will answer here. It may take until morning. Request number: {id}
ticketLinked: Done. The tutor's reply to request {id} will also come here.
alertsUsage: Send /alerts and a word, for example: /alerts accountant Addis Ababa
alertsOn: Alerts on for “{keyword}”. Send /stop to stop.
stopped: All your job alerts are stopped.
apiDown: The service is not reachable right now. Please try again later.
error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again, or send /person to reach a person.
menuReady: The menu is below. You can also type or speak.
helpText:
What I can do:
/ask – ask about the lesson (or just type or speak)
/lesson – the parts of the lesson
/person – talk to a person
/status – your request and the latest reply
/jobs – search test jobs
/alerts – job alerts, /myalerts – your alerts, /stop – stop alerts
/accommodate – ask for interview support
/lang – language, /simple – simple answers, /voice – voice replies
/mydata – what is stored, /delete – delete it
You can also say or type the words, for example “lesson” or “talk to a person”.
askPrompt: Type or say your question about the lesson.
lessonPick: Choose a part of the lesson:
lessonEmpty: There is no lesson content yet.
simpleOn: Simple answers are on: short, plain sentences.
voiceOn: Voice replies are on. Answers also come as a voice message.
voiceOff: Voice replies are off. Answers come as text only.
statusNone: You have no open request. Send /person to talk to a person.
statusNoReply: No reply yet. A tutor will answer here.
jobsUsage: Send /jobs and a word, for example: /jobs accountant. Open test jobs:
jobsNone: No open jobs match “{keyword}”. Send /alerts {keyword} to be told about new ones.
jobsTrust: Test data only. Check on the employer's own site. Never pay to apply.
myalertsNone: You have no job alerts. Send /alerts and a word to add one.
myalertsHeader: Your job alerts. Tap one to stop it:
accPickJob: Interview support goes to a career helper, never straight to the employer. Which job is it for?
accNoJobs: There are no open jobs to choose from.
accNeeds: What support do you need? Tap all that apply, then Done. You do not need to explain why.
accChooseOne: Please choose at least one kind of support.
accNote: Send a short note for the career helper, or tap Skip.
accSent: Sent. A career helper will contact you here. Your request goes to a person, not to the employer.
mydataText: Here is everything stored about this chat.
deleteConfirm: Delete everything stored about this chat (alerts, requests, conversation, language)? This cannot be undone.
cmd_status: Your request and the latest reply
voiceUnavailable: I could not make a voice message for this answer. It is shown as text.
